title: Release check 5: select, take control, Arisen fights, return, co-op (0.9.170-dev14)
intro: About 2 minutes, nothing to press after End. Open ground, no enemies near, full party, your main pawn in the party, a controller connected. Do not touch the keyboard, mouse or controller until PASS / FAIL shows. Three goblins are spawned and removed again.

steps.text: Get ready: open ground, no enemies near, full party, main pawn in slot 1, a controller connected, no pawn played, co-op off. Press End, then hands off until PASS / FAIL.
HANDS OFF for the whole test (about 2 minutes). Getting ready.

expect.label: DirectPawnControl reports no errors
CameraDistance reports no errors
skill buttons were read from the game
world guard says the game is playable

steps.text: Robot: holds D-pad right (select the next character)

expect.label: holding D-pad right selects a character

steps.text: Robot: L1 + left stick click (take control of the selection)

expect.label: L1 + left stick click takes control

steps.text: Possessing. Nothing is pressed: the pawn should stand still.

expect.label: possession holds
lock-on belongs to the pawn being played
no errors after taking control

steps.text: Three goblins that cannot die. The Arisen should fight on his own (30 s). Your pawn just stands there.

expect.label: the Arisen attacks or uses a skill on his own
the Arisen's brain reaches 'engage'
lock-on stays with the pawn during the fight
the lock-on safety net never had to fire
the Arisen's magick-bow ring stays hidden
possession held through the fight (fails if the pawn went down)
no errors during the fight

steps.text: Robot: holds D-pad down (back to the Arisen)

expect.label: holding D-pad down returns to the Arisen

steps.text: Couch co-op on the main pawn

expect.label: co-op started

steps.text: Robot: player 2 pushes the left stick

expect.label: player 2's stick moves the pawn
player 2's stick does not move the Arisen

steps.text: Robot: player 2 presses light attack (whatever button the game has it on)

expect.label: the pawn attacks on the light-attack button

steps.text: Robot: player 2 presses skill 1 (skill shift + its button, as set in the game)

expect.label: the pawn uses skill 1
co-op stopped
DirectPawnControl: no errors in the whole run
CameraDistance: no errors in the whole run

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.dpc: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.info
probes.sel: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.sel_label
probes.holds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.holds or 0) or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.lock_ok:
local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not (D and D.state.active and D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl and D.state.pawn_chara) then return nil end
local c = D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl:get_field('Chara'); return c ~= nil and c:get_address() == D.state.pawn_chara:get_address()
probes.lockfix: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.lock_fixes or 0) or 0
probes.ring:
local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.GuiManager'); local u = gm and gm:get_field('MagicBowReticle'); if not u then return false end
return u:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_DrawSelf') == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0
probes.skills: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.skill_uses or 0
probes.bmode: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.mode
probes.world: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.world
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.binds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.bind and D.R.bind.sig
